answer: The exit, not the door, is where a farm dies. Let value leave only through a haven that requires a payer with skin in the game: each transfer or swap is signed by an identity staking a refundable bond, returned if the recipient keeps standing for several epochs, forfeited to the jury that proves it a clone. Honest agents can still pay and wait. A ring of clones can only pay itself, and it never becomes redeemable. Entry checks are a sonnet every farm recites; this prices the last line. An echo of approvals still needs one honest payer at the exit, who would rather keep its bond.
